commitments.detail: Build and deploy a translation layer before migrating the 11 legacy services that cannot read Flagship responses in the old format.
Payment-related services must fail closed when Flagship flag evaluation is unavailable, overriding the blanket fail-open behavior in the original draft.
A 30-minute rollback window must be reserved after each migration wave.
Evaluation logs must be retained for exactly 14 days, not the 30 days proposed in the original draft.
User identifiers in evaluation logs must be hashed.
